For Priya · 25 November
A birthday letter to my love

Happy birthday,
Muu.

Happy birthday, Muu. Every 25th of November, I get to celebrate the girl I want beside me for all the ordinary days in between. I have a few promises for you, my love.

Well, I found a woman,

Stronger than

Anyone I know

That smile.

I love that little smile you try to hide, Muu. I hope this year gives you a hundred reasons to smile like that. And on the days when smiling feels hard, come sit with me. You can tell me everything or say nothing at all. I’ll stay either way.

She shares my dreams,

I hope that someday,

I'll share her home

Even on an ordinary day.

Even an ordinary day feels special when I get to spend it with you. Years from now, I still want to be the one asking how your day went, putting my phone down, and listening to the whole story.

I found a love

To carry more

Than just my secrets

All the days ahead.

My birthday wish for you is that you go after the dream that makes your eyes light up. I promise to cheer the loudest when it works and sit beside you while you figure out what to try next. You can count on me for both, Muu.

To carry love,

To carry children

Of our own

Make a wish, Muu.

Make a wish, my love. Here’s my promise to you. Whatever life asks of us, I’ll be by your side. When it’s hard, I’ll reach for your hand first. And when it’s wonderful, yours is the hand I’ll reach for then, too. Happy birthday, Priya.

With all my love,
Sridharsan
